meta.title: AutoLink — Your car can receive messages
meta.description: A QR sticker for your car. People can warn you about a problem without ever seeing your number.

home.title: Your car can receive messages.
home.subtitle: Lights left on, a blocked gate, a window open: whoever notices scans the sticker and lets you know. Your number stays private.

errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

generate.title: Generate a batch
generate.intro: Creates the tags and downloads a print-ready ZIP. Activation codes exist only in that ZIP — keep it somewhere safe.
generate.label: Batch name
generate.labelHint: Something you'll recognise, e.g. "September print run"
generate.done: Batch created. The download has started.

batches.label: Batch
batches.reissueConfirm: The current activation codes of this batch's unactivated tags will stop working, and a new ZIP will download. Continue?

errors.base_url_invalid: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL must be a bare origin, e.g. https://autolink.dz
errors.base_url_not_https: In production, QR codes must point to an https address.
errors.base_url_local_host: In production, QR codes cannot point to localhost or an IP address.
